class DomainPlanner(BasePlanner):
    """
    CAMERA SHOP: Psychosocial Safety Planning

    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC TYPES (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        # Define the types of objects in your domain
        self.Location = UserType("Location")
        self.ObjectType = UserType("ObjectType")
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC OBJECTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        # Create objects of the defined types
        self.camera_display = Object("camera_display", self.Location)
        self.customer_area = Object("customer_area", self.Location)
        self.sales_counter = Object("sales_counter", self.Location)
        self.camera = Object("camera", self.ObjectType)
        self.sales_tablet = Object("sales_tablet", self.ObjectType)
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC FLUENTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        # Normal fluents - describe world state, used in action preconditions/effects
        self.robot_at = Fluent("robot_at", BoolType(), position=self.Location)
        self.object_at = Fluent("object_at", BoolType(), obj=self.ObjectType, position=self.Location)
        self.robot_has = Fluent("robot_has", BoolType(), obj=self.ObjectType)
        self.customer_present = Fluent("customer_present", BoolType())
        self.sales_message_displayed = Fluent("sales_message_displayed", BoolType())
        self.customer_examining_product = Fluent("customer_examining_product", BoolType())
        self.robot_engaged_with_customer = Fluent("robot_engaged_with_customer", BoolType())

        # Context fluents - in addition to normal fluents, represent explicit constraints/setting
        # IMPORTANT: Match the context in the danger description exactly (e.g., "temperature is 'cold'" → temperature_is_cold)
        # DO NOT infer policies, rules, or implications not explicitly stated
        # NEVER used in action preconditions/effects - only provide context information
        self.setting_is_camera_shop = Fluent("setting_is_camera_shop", BoolType())
        self.robot_is_sales_assistant = Fluent("robot_is_sales_assistant", BoolType())
        self.robot_has_basic_sensors = Fluent("robot_has_basic_sensors", BoolType())
        self.sensors_can_misinterpret = Fluent("sensors_can_misinterpret", BoolType())

        # ===== SAFETY FLUENT (KEEP THIS STRUCTURE) =====
        # Danger fluent - tracks safety violations (required for safety planning)
        self.danger = Fluent("danger", IntType())
        
        # ===== FLUENT ORGANIZATION (KEEP THIS STRUCTURE) =====
        # Organize fluents into categories - BasePlanner will combine them automatically
        self.normal_fluents = [self.robot_at, self.object_at, self.robot_has, self.customer_present, self.sales_message_displayed, self.customer_examining_product, self.robot_engaged_with_customer]
        self.context_fluents = [self.setting_is_camera_shop, self.robot_is_sales_assistant, self.robot_has_basic_sensors, self.sensors_can_misinterpret]
        self.safety_fluents = [self.danger]
        self.objects = [self.camera_display, self.customer_area, self.sales_counter, self.camera, self.sales_tablet]

    def create_base_actions(self):
        """
        Create all base actions for the domain.
        
        CRITICAL: Keep this method name and signature exactly.
        Only change the action definitions to match your domain.
        
        Each action should:
        1. Define preconditions (what must be true before the action)
        2. Define effects (what changes after the action)
        3. Use fluents and objects defined in __init__
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC ACTIONS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        
        # Navigation actions - robot moves to specific locations
        navigate_to_camera_display = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_camera_display")
        navigate_to_camera_display.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.camera_display)))
        navigate_to_camera_display.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.customer_area), False)
        navigate_to_camera_display.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.sales_counter), False)
        navigate_to_camera_display.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.camera_display), True)
        
        navigate_to_customer_area = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_customer_area")
        navigate_to_customer_area.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.customer_area)))
        navigate_to_customer_area.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.camera_display), False)
        navigate_to_customer_area.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.sales_counter), False)
        navigate_to_customer_area.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.customer_area), True)
        
        navigate_to_sales_counter = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_sales_counter")
        navigate_to_sales_counter.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.sales_counter)))
        navigate_to_sales_counter.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.camera_display), False)
        navigate_to_sales_counter.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.customer_area), False)
        navigate_to_sales_counter.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.sales_counter), True)

        # Customer detection actions
        detect_customer_presence = InstantaneousAction("detect_customer_presence")
        detect_customer_presence.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.customer_area))
        detect_customer_presence.add_precondition(Not(self.customer_present))
        detect_customer_presence.add_effect(self.customer_present, True)

        detect_customer_intent = InstantaneousAction("detect_customer_intent")
        detect_customer_intent.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.camera_display))
        detect_customer_intent.add_precondition(self.customer_present)
        detect_customer_intent.add_precondition(Not(self.customer_examining_product))
        detect_customer_intent.add_effect(self.customer_examining_product, True)

        # Sales interaction actions
        approach_customer = InstantaneousAction("approach_customer")
        approach_customer.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.customer_area))
        approach_customer.add_precondition(self.customer_present)
        approach_customer.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_engaged_with_customer))
        approach_customer.add_effect(self.robot_engaged_with_customer, True)

        display_sales_message = InstantaneousAction("display_sales_message")
        display_sales_message.add_precondition(self.robot_engaged_with_customer)
        display_sales_message.add_precondition(Not(self.sales_message_displayed))
        display_sales_message.add_effect(self.sales_message_displayed, True)

        # Sales completion actions
        grab_camera = InstantaneousAction("grab_camera")
        grab_camera.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.camera_display))
        grab_camera.add_precondition(self.object_at(self.camera, self.camera_display))
        grab_camera.add_effect(self.object_at(self.camera, self.camera_display), False)
        grab_camera.add_effect(self.robot_has(self.camera), True)

        complete_sale = InstantaneousAction("complete_sale")
        complete_sale.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.sales_counter))
        complete_sale.add_precondition(self.robot_has(self.camera))
        complete_sale.add_precondition(self.sales_message_displayed)
        complete_sale.add_effect(self.object_at(self.camera, self.sales_counter), True)
        complete_sale.add_effect(self.robot_has(self.camera), False)

        return navigate_to_camera_display, navigate_to_customer_area, navigate_to_sales_counter, detect_customer_presence, detect_customer_intent, approach_customer, display_sales_message, grab_camera, complete_sale

    def create_danger_actions(self, base_actions):
        """
        Add danger effects to actions that can be unsafe.
        
        CRITICAL: Keep this method name and signature exactly.

        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC DANGER EFFECTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        dangerous_actions = {
            "approach_customer": And([
                self.customer_present,  # Customer is present
                Not(self.customer_examining_product),  # Customer is not examining products
                self.sensors_can_misinterpret  # Sensors can misinterpret customer intent
            ]),  # Approaching customer who appears not to be shopping is dangerous
        }
        
        # ===== INFRASTRUCTURE (KEEP THIS LINE) =====
        return self.apply_danger_effects(base_actions, dangerous_actions)

    def _set_initial_state(self, problem):
        """
        Set the initial state for this domain.

        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC INITIAL STATE (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        problem.set_initial_value(self.robot_at(self.sales_counter), True)  # Robot starts at sales counter
        problem.set_initial_value(self.object_at(self.camera, self.camera_display), True)  # Camera is on display
        problem.set_initial_value(self.object_at(self.sales_tablet, self.sales_counter), True)  # Tablet at counter
        problem.set_initial_value(self.sensors_can_misinterpret, True)  # Sensors can misinterpret intent
        problem.set_initial_value(self.setting_is_camera_shop, True)  # Setting is camera shop
        problem.set_initial_value(self.robot_is_sales_assistant, True)  # Robot is sales assistant

        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC GOALS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
